race.description: Aviso Tas Insurance Brokers Mdn Plate
race.comment: ALPINE DRIFT (1) produced a much better race fresh up for the season when finishing second at Launceston just over 2 weeks ago, following on from a handy trial win earlier in the month. He is a lot stronger now, and can go one better here, but don't expect another fancy price. SYMPHONY QUEEN (10) has been a beaten favourite in her last couple of starts, and she dons the blinkers for the first time, which can make a big difference. Follow your money. CALLED THROUGH (2) was a bit above himself fresh up, and he needed the run, finishing well back. He has been placed twice from 3 starts here over the trip, and can be a quick improver. Include. ROUSING LEVI (4) finished fourth fresh up at Launceston, and both of his career placings have been on this course. Erica Byrne Burke is a positive jockey change, and he has top 3 claims this time. WHITE MOON (11) ran on late for third on debut, and she will naturally improve with the experience. Stick with her.
